summary: Build ISO 9001 QMS implementation skills with PECB training. Prepare for the Lead Implementer exam and plan effective QMS improvement.
audienceIntro: This ISO 9001 Lead Implementer course suits professionals who coordinate QMS implementation and ongoing operation, advise on quality management, or contribute to product and service quality. You should have a general understanding of quality management concepts and ISO 9001 requirements.
modules: QMS Evaluation and Certification Audit Preparation
prerequisites: To attend, you should have a general understanding of quality management concepts and ISO 9001 requirements, together with basic knowledge of management system implementation principles.
